messages:
Lina: Heads-up: onboarding Tempest11B (opt-arch) into int4 pipeline. Smoke shows repeating chunks after ~100-140 tokens on long summaries. Float32 runs are clean.
Ravi: can you paste the minimal repro + conversion flags?
Lina: repro: curl /generate with quant=int4, temp=0, max_tokens=400. sample: "...the report concluded that the report concluded that the report concluded..."
Tao: repeating phrase often points to positional modulation collapse. Tempest uses a hybrid rotary+abs-pos concat. Tiny-valued rotary freqs zeroed during calibration could flatten attention.
Lina: conversion logs snippet: 
[converter] layer=35 head=7 qk_scale mean=9.1e-05 -> clipped to 0.0
[converter] rotary_freqs min=8.3e-07 clipped->0.0
Ravi: we added an "aggressive-min-span" fallback in the calibration script to avoid degenerate min==max ranges; looks like it overshot tiny tensors.
Lina: ran head-entropy probe via eval-bot.
eval-bot: Headwise attention entropy (seed=7): float32 mean_entropy=4.1 bits; int4 (converted) mean_entropy=1.1 bits; zeroed rotary heads: 7, 14, 23.
Tao: low entropy + zeroed rotary = deterministic repetition. Two mitigations: change calibration floor per-tensor or mark tiny rotary tensors as mix-float to compute in fp32 at runtime.
Ravi: quick sanity: re-converted with min-span=1e-6 and preserved per-head scale. New artifact /artifacts/tempest-int4-minspan1e-6.bin; same prompt -> no repetition.
Lina: full eval (summaries val set) running: prelim numbers: int4(orig) ROUGE-1=0.30 ROUGE-L=0.26; int4(minspan1e-6) ROUGE-1=0.46 ROUGE-L=0.42; float32=0.48/0.44.
Tao: good recovery. Proposal: revert aggressive-min-span, add per-tensor floor default 1e-7 and headwise override for rotary tensors to 1e-6, plus QA unit that fails if repeated token ngram >3 in long-gen test.
Ravi: I'll add runtime guard: if rotary_freqs for a head are zeroed, bypass quant kernel for q/k for that head (mix precision).
Lina: opening PR with conversion fix, artifact links, bench logs. run ids: run-20260322-tempest-minspan1e-6, run-20260322-tempest-int4-orig. PR: https://git.redwood/tempest/compare/PR-1234
ops-bot: schedule canary deploy to dedicated pool after CI green and perf smoke.
Lina: also verified tokenizer parity: Tempest tokenizer normalizes ZWJ (U+200D). Confirmed same NFKC path in convert and runtime; added tokenizer-hash to artifact.
Tao: nice catch. If CI + bench look good, promote new int4 recipe and deprecate old artifact.
Lina: thanks all, will post PR link when ready. :rocket:
